title: Встроить IdempotencyCoordinator, capability policy и crash/fencing gate
summary: Подключить P4.2/P4.3 store к supported tool-invoke path, провести capability policy и выпустить проверяемый receipt, что stale worker не публикует результат, а exactly-once не обещается.
why: Store CAS does not close F04 while `SliceToolCoordinator`, `ScenarioRunner` and `ToolPort.call` still invoke tools without a lease. `RAG:—`.

include: `IdempotencyCoordinator`; capability catalog and high-risk classification from `side_effect`; heartbeat during invoke; native_key key forwarding; probe port for `read_before_write`; fail-closed unknown high-risk; consumer migration of reference/scenario paths; restart/multi-worker gate; PHP/Dart parity receipt; residual notes for P5/P6/P7/P8.
exclude: P2 authorization redesign; P3 token consume; event append/epoch; new spec revision; final barrel/PSR-4 removals; public docs/release; saga/outbox implementation; claiming exactly-once tool side effects.

rules: Supported mutation/`idempotent_commit` invoke goes through the coordinator. Omitting store/catalog is a construction error, not a silent unfenced call. High-risk + unknown denies before acquire. Takeover + non-retryable capability calls `fail(lease, ambiguous)` without `ToolPort.call`. Heartbeat uses the lease from acquire. Layer tests fail if a new unfenced `complete(request)` or direct `ToolPort.call` bypass reappears on migrated consumers. PostgreSQL crash/takeover test is mandatory for close; in-memory restart is not a substitute. Receipt derives case/result/code sets from real test output and names P5/P6/P7/P8 residual owners. No safe result claims exactly-once external effect.
guidance: Keep `ToolPort.call` signature; pass the durable key for `native_key`. Do not merge lease attempt into journal epoch. Redact tokens. Frozen harness may acquire internally so `2026-08` vectors still observe three states without new spec bytes.
